svg.text: DiT-XL/2 实现级网络架构 · 纵向展开版
Implementation-Level Architecture · all expanded module data flows read from top to bottom
A. 主干数据流 / Main Data Flow
左侧只保留模块接口；右侧用同一编号按自上而下顺序展开。
condition side path; never concatenated with image tokens
All 28 blocks have identical structure but independent trainable parameters.
B. 抽象模块详细设计 / Expanded Modules
每个模块均从上到下阅读；紫色 residual 走左旁路，绿色 condition 从右侧汇入。
Training uses classifier-free label dropout; inference can provide null id explicitly.
Green paths are broadcast modulation only; they never concatenate with token features.
Equivalent to timm Attention(hidden_size=1152, num_heads=16, qkv_bias=True, attn_drop=0, proj_drop=0).
The same MLP weights are applied independently to each of the 256 token positions.
No spatial convolution and no token mixing occur inside this branch; token mixing is handled by MHA.
Channels 0:4 = ε / mean parameterization; channels 4:8 = learned covariance.
Official forward_with_cfg guides only [:,:3]; remaining output channels pass through unchanged.
Implementation reference: facebookresearch/DiT models.py. Diagram v3 uses a unified top-to-bottom reading direction for every expanded module.
